output.headline: Loss to Tallowmere: Build from process, not the scoreboard
what_decided_it: Tallowmere had big innings: 5 runs in inning 1, 3 runs in inning 3, and 3 runs in inning 5.
Wrenmoor committed 6 errors as a team.
We had 4 hits in 25 plate appearances with 7 strikeouts (28% of plate appearances), and our pitchers allowed 5 walks while recording 4 strikeouts.
strengths: Team on-base rate of 44% with 5 walks and 4 hits in 25 plate appearances.
0 passed balls and 52% strikes thrown by our pitchers.

priorities.title: Two-strike approach: protect the zone and put the ball in play
priorities.why: 11 plate appearances reached two strikes and 7 of 25 plate appearances ended in strikeouts, including 3 called third strikes.

insights.insight: With two strikes, protect the zone: widen what you'll swing at, shorten the swing, choke up slightly, and try to put the ball in play or foul off tough pitches.

priorities.title: Defensive readiness and error reduction
priorities.why: The team committed 6 errors in the game.

insights.insight: Focus on what you control: being ready, your approach, effort and how you respond. Hits and wins depend partly on luck; a good at-bat can still be an out.

priorities.title: Pitching efficiency: throw more first-pitch strikes and manage workload
priorities.why: Pitchers allowed 5 walks, threw 52% strikes, and first-pitch strikes to 52% of batters across 103 pitches (22.1 per inning).

insights.insight: Follow pitch counts and rest days, don't pitch on three days in a row, avoid catching on non-pitching days, and take time off from throwing each year.

lesson.title: A game built on failure
lesson.principle: In baseball, succeeding about 30% of the time at the plate can make a Hall of Fame career at the professional level. That's a 70% failure rate. You will not win every competition, and you will not lose every competition, but you will learn and grow through every competition.
lesson.life_lesson: Failing often on the way to success is normal in anything worth doing; what matters is learning from each try.

output.team_talk: I’m proud of how you competed out there. Baseball is a game of failure, and every out and error is just information for the next time. Let’s keep believing in each other and get back to work.
at_home: On the ride home, let the player talk first and say, “I love watching you play.”
Check bat weight: hold the bat by the handle with one arm straight out for 20–30 seconds; if the barrel drops, it may be too heavy.
Make sure the bat is legal for your league and fits your length and weight for control and bat speed.
